topic: Reviewing dwell time and analytics differences
summary_markdown:
The participants discussed discrepancies in data viewing, specifically regarding 'dwell time' metrics. They reviewed the analytics dashboard using both `analytics.allunite.com` and `staging-analytics.allunite.com`. It was noted that while the data appeared largely similar for a specific date range (April 3 to April 10), there were technical differences in how the dashboards loaded, requiring users to click the AllUnite icon to reset tracking installations.

Later, one participant confirmed deleting a task related to dwell time.
decisions: The participants agreed on reviewing dwell time metrics using the analytics platform.
